cook.name: Cook's Assistant
cook.start: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.
rewards: Permission to use the Cook's range

1.text: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen to start the quest.

2.text: Buy a bucket from the Lumbridge General Store.

3.text: Buy a pot from the Lumbridge General Store.

4.text: Pick up an egg from the chicken farm north of Lumbridge, across the river.

5.text: Pick some wheat in the field north of Lumbridge.

6.text: Climb the ladder in the mill to the top floor.

7.text: Climb up the ladder again to the top floor.

8.text: Use your grain on the hopper.

10.text: Climb down the ladder to the ground floor.

11.text: Climb down the ladder to the ground floor.

12.text: Use your pot on the flour bin to collect the flour.

13.text: Use your bucket on a cow in the field north of the mill.

14.text: Bring the Cook the egg, the milk and the flour.

priestperil.name: Priest in Peril
priestperil.start: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.
skills: Able to defeat a level 30 dog and level 30 monks

1.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.

2.text: Knock at the temple door, east of Varrock where the River Salve starts, and say Roald sent you.
options: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.

3.text: Open and climb down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple.

4.text: Kill the temple guardian, the dog in the room underground.

6.text: Go back to King Roald in Varrock Palace and tell him the dog is dead.

7.text: Go into the temple (the doors are open now) and up the stairs. Zamorakian monks (level 30) attack you inside.

8.text: Climb the ladder to the top floor.

9.text: Talk-through the cell door to Drezel. Pick 'Tell me anyway.' and then 'Yes.'

10.text: Kill the Zamorakian monks in the temple until one drops a golden key, and pick it up.

11.text: Take the golden key down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple.

12.text: Go through the gate and study the monuments: use the golden key on the one that reads 'Saradomin is the key that unlocks the mysteries of life' to swap it for the iron key.

13.text: Use a bucket on the well in the middle of the monuments to fill it with murky water.

14.text: You need water from the well under the mausoleum: take a bucket down the trapdoor north of the temple.

15.text: Climb back up the ladder and go to the top of the temple.

16.text: Go up the stairs in the temple.

17.text: Climb the ladder to the top floor.

18.text: Use the iron key on the cell door.

19.text: Use the bucket of murky water on Drezel so he blesses it.

20.text: Use the blessed water on the vampire's coffin.

22.text: Go down the trapdoor in the mausoleum north of the temple to meet Drezel by the monuments.

23.text: Go through the gates past the monuments and talk to Drezel in the room to the east.

24.text: Bring Drezel 50 rune essence (not noted). He takes them under the mausoleum, past the monuments.

25.text: Use the rune essence on Drezel, past the monuments under the mausoleum.

waterfall.name: Waterfall Quest
waterfall.start: Talk to Almera in her house north of the Baxtorian Falls.
skills: Glarial's tomb lets in no weapons, armour, runes or arrows: bank them first

1.text: Talk to Almera in her house north of the Baxtorian Falls.

2.text: Board the log raft by the river to float down to Hudon.

3.text: Talk to Hudon on the island.

4.text: Leave the island: swim for the rock to the south and the current washes you ashore.

5.text: Go to Hadley's house by the falls and climb the stairs.

6.text: Search the bookcase for the Book on Baxtorian.

8.text: Go into the Tree Gnome Village (through the maze) and climb down the ladder to the cellar.

9.text: Search the crate in the far east of the cellar for a key.

10.text: Use the key on Golrie's gate and talk to Golrie.

11.text: Talk to Golrie and look through his junk for Glarial's pebble.

12.text: Bank every weapon, armour piece, rune and arrow, then use Glarial's pebble on Glarial's tombstone, east of the falls.

13.text: Open the chest in Glarial's tomb and search it for Glarial's amulet.

14.text: Search Glarial's coffin for her urn.

15.text: Climb the ladder out of the tomb.

16.text: Back to the falls with a rope, 6 air, 6 earth and 6 water runes, Glarial's amulet and urn: board the log raft.

17.text: Use the rope on the rock to the south.

18.text: Use the rope on the dead tree to let yourself down onto the ledge.

19.text: Wear Glarial's amulet and open the door into the falls.

20.text: Search the crate in the east of the cave for a key.

21.text: Use the key on the door in the north-west of the cave.

22.text: Use an air, an earth and a water rune on each of the six pillars.

23.text: Use Glarial's amulet on the statue of Glarial.

24.text: With 5 free spaces, use Glarial's urn on the chalice.

troll.name: Troll Stronghold
troll.start: Talk to Denulth in his tent at the Imperial Guard camp in Burthorpe (after Death Plateau).
skills: Level 30 Thieving (to take the cell keys without a fight)
Able to defeat a level 113 troll
rewards: The way to the troll country

1.text: Talk to Denulth in his tent at the Imperial Guard camp in Burthorpe and offer to get Godric back.
options: How goes your fight with the trolls?
Is there anything I can do to help?

2.text: Buy climbing boots from Tenzing the Sherpa, west of Burthorpe (12 coins).
options: Can I buy some Climbing boots?

3.text: Wear the climbing boots, climb up Death Plateau and go through the door into the arena.

4.text: Talk to the Troll Champion (Dad), accept his challenge and defeat him (level 113).

5.text: Leave the arena by the north door.

6.text: Go north-west over the rocks (Agility 15) to the Troll Stronghold and go in through the door.

7.text: Kill one of the Troll Generals on the top floor of the stronghold for the prison key.

8.text: Go down the stairs in the north of the stronghold.

9.text: Open the prison door with the prison key.

10.text: Go down the stairs into the prison.

11.text: Pickpocket the sleeping prison guards (Thieving 30) or kill them for the cell keys: the first guard has Godric's.

12.text: Use cell key 1 on Godric's cell door.

13.text: Optional: use cell key 2 on Mad Eadgar's cell door to free him too.

14.text: Leave the stronghold by the door in the south-west of the prison level.

15.text: Tell Dunstan, the smith in Burthorpe, that his son Godric is safe.

ikov.name: Temple of Ikov
ikov.start: Talk to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne.
skills: A light source (lit candle, torch or lantern) and a tinderbox
A bow that fires ice arrows (shortbow or longbow)
You must weigh under 0 kg to cross the lava bridge

1.text: Talk to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in East Ardougne and agree to get the Staff of Armadyl.

2.text: With a light source, a bow and 20 limpwurt roots, climb down the ladder into the Temple of Ikov, by the statues north-east of East Ardougne.

3.text: Go down the dark stairs in the west with your light source lit.

4.text: Pick up the boots of lightness, then go back up the stairs.

5.text: Wear the boots of lightness and bank or drop enough to weigh under 0 kg, cross the lava bridge and pick up the lever on the far side.

6.text: Use the lever on the lever bracket in the east, then pull it to open the gate south of it.

7.text: Go through the south gate and search the chests in the ice spiders' cave until you find ice arrows.

8.text: Wear Lucien's pendant, go through the north door (it fills you with fear without it) and search the lever for traps (Thieving 42).

10.text: Go through the door to the west and kill the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus with ice arrows (wield a bow).

11.text: Talk to Winelda in the north.

12.text: Bring Winelda 20 limpwurt roots (not noted) and talk to her: she teleports you across.

13.text: Take off Lucien's pendant and talk to a Guardian of Armadyl: side with them against Lucien.
options: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.
Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!
You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.

14.text: Take the Staff of Armadyl to Lucien in his house in north-west Varrock.

15.text: Wear the Pendant of Armadyl and kill Lucien in his house in north-west Varrock.
